segments.text:
GOd, whiche knoweſte vs to be ſet in the myddeſte of ſo many and great daungers, that for mans fraylneſſe we
cannot alwayes ſtande vprightly: Graunt to vs the health of body and ſoule, that all thoſe thynges whiche we ſuffer for ſynne, by thy helpe we maye well paſſe and ouercome, through Chriſt our Lorde.
